reviews.text: Great place. Staff were brilliant. Got everything I needed. Well done everyone 👍🐕🐕🐩🐾🐾🐾. Hello again I just wanted to mention Joanne is fantastic at grooming our cat BULMERS ..... best cat groomer around …
Great staff members who are very knowledgeable and accommodating. Couldn't recommend them highly enough.

Got our cat groomed here with Joanne, she's amazing. A couple of weeks back I visited the shop to enquire about an appointment. We were nervous as our cat has a heart condition  and other issues.
Joanne was very knowledgeable on what our cat was going through and reassured us our cat was her priority and not the groom itself. Needless to say we went ahead and found out our little man was playing us for a fool as when he met joanne he looked like a different cat. The way she handled him was amazing, iv never seen him so happy with a stranger.
We will be back, thank so much.

Ps the shop is amazing and the staff are friendly and knowledgeable on their brands and dietary needs. Great shop worth a visit.

Joanne groomed our cat and she was absolutely fantastic.

She knew exactly how to put our cat (and us) at ease.

Extremely professional and knowledgeable.

Would absolutely recommend.

Joanne at Pet Plus has been grooming my boy Link for 4 years now and she’s the only person we will use. She’s patient, really takes the time to make nervous cats feel at ease, she doesn’t push them past what they’re comfortable with and does exactly what I ask. I was so nervous leaving him the first time but when I got back he was enjoying a blow dry and relaxing. Joanne is great with giving advice on how to maintain the results and ensuring we can keep our fluffy boy as handsome as always. Thanks so much Joanne, wouldn’t go to anyone else ❤️🙏
She took care of our long haired cat and we've gone back everything and he loves it there!
Love, love, love going here. The groomer is very knowledgeable and gave me great advice about managing my Persian cat after her groom. And the shop staff were also very helpful.

It was the first time I took a cat to shear. And the last one in this place. When I got home, I was scared. 😱For such a large amount of money, they cut it off so crookedly.... 😣The back of the cat's head is cut crookedly, with pits. One cheek is round, and the other is as if cut in a straight line. You look at the animal and you want to cry. 😔All the fur in crooked stripes of some kind. I'm no longer talking about the fact that I can't take a cat on my lap like I used to, she used to like to roll on her back, stretch out everything, and now she is afraid, biting to my hand, kicking so as not to turn her over. 😥I don't know what happened to the animal groomer, or what kind of student was given a haircut, but how for 85 euros I should be happy looking at it after taking the pet, and now....

Cat Groomer Joanne - Pets Plus Fermoy

Joanne is an absolutely incredible cat groomer, I have taken my cat to her once and he is going again in a month’s time! She has been absolutely incredible from all aspects from answering questions to the grooming appointment itself.

She is incredibly gentle, patient, kind, and it’s clear as day to see how much she loves & cares about the animals she is working with. Cannot recommend Joanne enough 🌟

My cat gets groomed here. He loves it! He hates me brushing him but for some reason (I can only think Joanne is some kind of magical cat whisperer) he loves having his bath and groom. He comes home feeling fabulous about himself and smells delicious 🤩 his only complaint is that I keep picking him up and trying to inhale him afterwards! …

Hi 2 cats Joey chinchilla  persian and Remy maincoonare regulars with joanne for their grooming sessions.  Bath , deshedding , sanitary shave and blow dry . They are like 2 super stars coming out.  I am so happy with the service and joanne is mad about cats.  For me the best is that the cars are not put to sleep for their grooming.  She has an aura with that cats and she will win them over and even when Joey gives her a bit of sass she gets around him and give the best grooming .

She is simply the best cat groomer

Love going to pets plus in Fermoy! Joanne is absolutely brilliant at what she does. My cat, Delilah gets groomed every 8 weeks here and she loves it. Always comes out looking and smelling amazing and very calm ☺️Joanne always so helpful and informative!!

Highly recommend Joanne for cat grooming. Our cat is large and extremely hairy. He is also not the tamest fella. Joanne handles him so well and he comes out of there happy and content but also very well groomed.
Reptile deliverys always on time and in excellent condition highly recommend
Friendly staff and loads of options of pet food and accessories
Very helpful staff, great range of pet items. They also have a top dog groomer, very experienced.
Small but great shop , I found everything I needed there
